newsitem.title: USA: AT&T says wins $115 mln contract from NCR Corp.
newsitem.headline: AT&T says wins $115 mln contract from NCR Corp.

text.p: AT&T Corp said Tuesday it has won a contract from NCR Corp worth $115 million over the next three years for data and voice communications services.
The company said NCR contracted internationally for its worldsource frame relay service to reach its offices in North America, Europe, and the Caribbean-Latin America and Asia-Pacific regions.
In the United States, the company said NCR also contracted for virtual telecommunications network services for voice, data, and video connectivity.
The company said its worldsource frame relay service offers high-speed data transfer.
The company said that among the services it will provide for NCR under the contract is connecting all NCR employees to the Internet and to electronic-mail.
AT&T said it competed for the contract against three other global carriers.
The company was not immediately able to identify those carriers.
